overview: The main stories are earnings and AI products. Tesla beat on EPS but missed on revenue in Q3. Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive agent app, and Gemini 4 Argon topped an accounting benchmark. Other notable posts: OpenAI led a fix for a severe open-source bug (php2shell), Ray Dalio warned about AI concentration risk, and there were several funding rounds and model releases. Much of Musk's feed was midterm politics, which is skipped here.

top_items.title: elonmusk - Tesla Q3: EPS $0.48 vs $0.45 est, revenue $28.05B (missed), FSD subs up 67% to 1.74M, Semi in volume production
MatthewBerman - Anthropic opens a research preview of Claude Duet, a proactive agent that keeps working and checks before acting
gdb - OpenAI spent two months leading a coalition to mitigate php2shell, which he calls one of the most severe open-source bugs in recent memory
sundarpichai - Ramp says Gemini 4 Argon tops its Accounting Bench at 61.1%, 10.6 points ahead of Opus 5.5
RayDalio - Watch Treasury yields and spreads, and the heavy AI concentration in markets; he is diversifying away from it
MatthewBerman - Sam Altman interview: AI and coding jobs, personal assistants, why ChatGPT is too agreeable, OpenAI's chip bet
saranormous - Conviction co-led a $35M seed for Watchtower Labs, an AI decision layer for military logistics, with Founders Fund
brian_armstrong - Mastercard is using Coinbase's x402 infrastructure, via Cloudflare, so AI agents can pay for digital services
